Hello Sarah, John, Priya — Professor Alvarez here. I'd like to hold our CSE455 staff meeting next week (Nov 23–27). Next week is tightly booked for me, so the only free windows I have inside working hours are:

- Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30
- Mon Nov 23, 14:00–14:30
- Tue Nov 24, 11:00–11:30
- Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30
- Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30
- Wed Nov 25, 13:00–13:30

So it would be a 30-minute meeting. Which of these works for each of you? If none does, tell me when you are free and I'll see what I can move. Once we agree, I'll put it in my calendar and confirm here.

- Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30 — free
- Mon Nov 23, 14:00–14:30 — free

Any of the five is fine with me — I have no preference. John, Priya, what about you?
